title: Stage-order repair for model-dependent observed FHIR query-trace coverage

founder_authorization.scope: protocol stage-order repair only; does not itself close D2, select a model, activate training, or authorize final-role access

rationale.verified_fact: At frozen FHIR-AgentBench revision bbb42909a5a7eb907d1cd91f72a560729e7037ea, observed direct-request FHIR query arguments are produced through safe_llm_call with an explicit model and an explicit agent strategy.
rationale.circular_dependency: The original D2 contract requires observed governed query-pattern coverage before D2 closeout while also forbidding model selection and keeping D3 inactive.
rationale.repair_type: pre-results stage-order repair; no criterion is removed, weakened, waived, or reinterpreted

D2.closeout_rule: D2 may close only after every model-independent D2 exit criterion is genuinely satisfied and canonically qualified.
model_independent_exit_criteria: B0/B1/B2 matched-input base-answer identity mechanically proven
B1/B2 differ from B0 only by preregistered score/action wrapper semantics
deterministic complete denominator and failure accounting
local retrieval matches governed development-role expected resource IDs with no unresolved behavior-changing semantic drift
all negative and unsupported results retained
no model selection, training, DAL development, final calibration fitting, or sealed-final access occurred
D2.deferred_but_mandatory_criterion: every governed development-role FHIR query pattern is supported or explicitly blocking

preconditions: this amendment is canonical and post-main verified
D2 is separately closed canonically on model-independent evidence only
D3.allowed_after_preconditions: prospectively select and freeze the Study 1 base model and FHIR agent strategy without final-role data
prohibitions: no final-role data, supervision, traces, outputs, or labels
no performance-driven choice from development query-trace outcomes

post_D3_pre_D4_query_trace_gate.producer_identity: the prospectively frozen D3 base model plus FHIR agent strategy
post_D3_pre_D4_query_trace_gate.custodian: founder-authorized blind development-only query-trace custodian from Issue #126
post_D3_pre_D4_query_trace_gate.required_result: every observed normalized FHIR query/search pattern is exercised and either supported or recorded as a behavior-changing blocker
